title.zh-CN: AI 生成不等于已验证
title.en: AI output is not verified work

summary.zh-CN: AI 生成只产出候选方案；只有运行、测试或可核对的证据才能把候选变成结果。每个任务都要分开记录「生成了什么」与「验证了什么」。
summary.en: AI generation only produces candidates; only execution, tests or checkable evidence turn a candidate into a result. Every task must record separately what was generated and what was verified.

zh-CN: 区分「模型说可以」与「命令实际成功」两类说法
为一次改动写下生成动作与验证证据两类记录
en: Separate what the model says from what the command actually returned
Record generated actions and verification evidence separately for one change

prompt.zh-CN: 找一段最近让 AI 写的代码，补一张两列表：左列写「生成过程」，右列写「验证证据」；无法填出证据的项标为未验证。
prompt.en: Take a recent AI-written change and add two columns: generated actions on the left, verification evidence on the right; mark rows without evidence as unverified.

hint.zh-CN: 验证证据必须是可复现的命令、测试输出或截图观察，不能是「看起来没问题」。
hint.en: Evidence must be a reproducible command, test output or observed screenshot, not 'it looks fine'.

summary.zh-CN: 写 prompt 前先明确目标、输入输出、边界与不可改动范围；让 AI 先复述需求并列出歧义问题，再开始实现。
summary.en: Before prompting, pin down goal, inputs and outputs, boundaries and off-limits areas; ask the AI to restate the requirement and list ambiguities before implementing.

zh-CN: 把一句话需求扩写成目标、约束与验收点
识别需求里缺失的边界并先提问
en: Expand a one-line request into goal, constraints and acceptance points
Spot missing boundaries and ask first

prompt.zh-CN: 把「做个搜索页」扩写成含目标用户、输入、结果排序、空状态、性能上限与不做事项的需求说明。
prompt.en: Expand 'build a search page' into a requirement covering target user, inputs, result ordering, empty state, performance ceiling and out-of-scope items.

hint.zh-CN: 写出「不做」范围能显著减少返工；每条验收点都要能被验证。
hint.en: Stating out-of-scope items greatly reduces rework; every acceptance point must be verifiable.

title.en: Acceptance criteria and definition of done

summary.zh-CN: 验收标准是可观察的结果描述，完成定义是任务关闭前必须满足的清单；两者都要在编码前写下并在结束时逐条核对。
summary.en: Acceptance criteria describe observable outcomes and the definition of done is the checklist a task must satisfy before closing; write both before coding and check them one by one at the end.

zh-CN: 为一功能写出可观察、可判定的验收标准
用完成定义逐条收尾而不是凭感觉结束
en: Write observable, decidable acceptance criteria for a feature
Close work by walking the definition of done, not by feeling

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个「离线词典搜索」功能写 5 条验收标准与 6 条完成定义，并标注每条如何验证。
prompt.en: Write five acceptance criteria and six definition-of-done items for an offline dictionary search, each with how it is verified.

hint.zh-CN: 验收示例：空查询返回提示且不崩溃；验证方式：运行单测或手动步骤。
hint.en: Example criterion: an empty query shows a hint and does not crash; verification: a unit test or manual steps.

summary.zh-CN: 只给完成任务必需的文件、片段与报错；无关代码、全量仓库和敏感配置会稀释注意力并增加泄露风险。
summary.en: Provide only the files, excerpts and errors the task needs; unrelated code, the whole repository and sensitive configuration dilute attention and increase leak risk.

zh-CN: 为一次任务列出最小上下文清单
删掉与任务无关的上下文并说明理由
en: List the minimal context for one task
Remove unrelated context and justify why

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个按钮点击报错的任务准备上下文包：需要的文件片段、报错文本、环境信息，以及你主动排除的内容。
prompt.en: Prepare a context bundle for a failing button click: the needed excerpts, the error text, environment info and what you deliberately left out.

hint.zh-CN: 排除密钥、完整日志与无关模块；报错文本要保留完整堆栈而不是只截一行。
hint.en: Leave out secrets, full logs and unrelated modules; keep the full stack trace rather than one line.

summary.zh-CN: 一次只提出一个可验证的改动目标，附上当前代码、期望行为与验证命令；根据上一轮的真实结果决定下一轮，而不是连续堆需求。
summary.en: Request one verifiable change at a time with current code, expected behavior and a verification command; decide the next round from real results instead of stacking requests.

zh-CN: 把大需求拆成按验证结果推进的多轮 prompt
在 prompt 中带上验证方式与失败处理要求
en: Split a big request into rounds driven by verification results
Include verification and failure-handling requirements in the prompt

prompt.zh-CN: 把「实现登录」拆成 4 轮迭代 prompt，每轮写出目标、改动范围、验证命令与通过标准。
prompt.en: Split 'implement login' into four iterative prompts, each with goal, edit scope, verification command and pass criteria.

hint.zh-CN: 第一轮可先只做输入校验与失败提示，跑通单测后再接网络层。
hint.en: The first round might only add input validation and error messages, with the network layer after unit tests pass.

summary.zh-CN: 每个改动尽量小到可独立审查和回滚；一次只做一件事，改完立即验证并提交，避免大批量生成后无法定位问题。
summary.en: Keep each change small enough to review and revert independently; do one thing at a time, verify immediately and commit, so a large batch never hides the failure source.

zh-CN: 把一次大改动拆成可独立验证的小步
解释小步与提交粒度的关系
en: Split a large change into independently verifiable steps
Explain how step size relates to commit granularity

prompt.zh-CN: 把一个「重构 + 加功能」的请求拆成 3 个小步，说明每步的验证方式与提交信息。
prompt.en: Split a 'refactor plus feature' request into three small steps and state the verification and commit message for each.

hint.zh-CN: 先纯重构并确保测试通过，再添加功能；每步提交都能单独回滚。
hint.en: Refactor first and keep tests green, then add the feature; each commit can be reverted alone.

summary.zh-CN: 不阅读生成的完整文件，只看 diff：确认改动范围符合预期、没有意外删除、没有调试残留，再决定是否接受。
summary.en: Read the diff rather than the generated full file: confirm the scope matches intent, nothing was deleted unexpectedly and no debug leftovers remain before accepting.

zh-CN: 按检查清单审阅 AI 生成的 diff
识别超出任务范围的意外改动
en: Review AI-generated diffs against a checklist
Spot out-of-scope accidental changes

prompt.zh-CN: 为一次 AI 改动写下 diff 审查清单：范围、删除、错误处理、测试、格式、敏感信息六项各写一句检查动作。
prompt.en: Write a diff-review checklist for one AI change with one check action each for scope, deletions, error handling, tests, formatting and sensitive data.

hint.zh-CN: 先看统计再看逐行；被删的代码和新增依赖最需要警惕。
hint.en: Read the stats first, then the lines; deleted code and new dependencies deserve the most suspicion.

summary.zh-CN: 让 AI 同时给出测试与实现，并在本地真实运行测试；测试输出、退出码与覆盖的边界情况才是验证证据。
summary.en: Have the AI provide tests together with the implementation and run them for real locally; test output, exit codes and covered edge cases are the evidence.

zh-CN: 为一个改动补上可运行的最小测试
用测试输出与退出码作为完成证据
en: Add a minimal runnable test for a change
Use test output and exit codes as completion evidence

prompt.zh-CN: 为一段解析函数让 AI 生成 4 个测试用例（正常、空、超长、非法），运行并记录实际输出与退出码。
prompt.en: Have the AI generate four tests for a parser (normal, empty, overlong, invalid), run them and record the actual output and exit code.

hint.zh-CN: 测试必须真的跑过：粘贴真实输出；失败时修实现而不是改断言。
hint.en: The tests must really run: paste real output; on failure fix the implementation rather than the assertion.

summary.zh-CN: 调试靠证据而不是猜测：稳定复现步骤、完整报错、最小输入、改动前后对比；每轮尝试都要产生新证据。
summary.en: Debugging rests on evidence, not guesses: stable reproduction steps, full errors, a minimal input and before/after comparison; every attempt must yield new evidence.

zh-CN: 写出可稳定复现问题的最小步骤
用报错与日志区分「猜测」与「证据」
en: Write minimal steps that reproduce the problem reliably
Use errors and logs to separate guesses from evidence

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个偶发崩溃写复现卡：环境、输入、操作步骤、完整报错、已排除的原因；说明下一轮要收集什么新证据。
prompt.en: Write a reproduction card for an intermittent crash: environment, input, steps, full error and ruled-out causes; state what new evidence the next round collects.

hint.zh-CN: 偶发问题先记录时间与频率；没有完整堆栈时不要下结论。
hint.en: For intermittent bugs record timing and frequency first; do not conclude without a full stack trace.

summary.zh-CN: 改动前确认干净状态，小步提交形成检查点；一旦验证失败先回滚到最近检查点，再重新分析，而不是在错误基础上继续叠加。
summary.en: Confirm a clean state before changes and commit in small steps to create checkpoints; when verification fails, roll back to the last checkpoint and re-analyze instead of stacking more changes.

zh-CN: 用 git status/diff 确认改动前状态
在验证失败时回滚到检查点并说明原因
en: Check the pre-change state with git status and diff
Roll back to a checkpoint after a failed verification and explain why

prompt.zh-CN: 模拟一次 AI 改动导致测试失败：写出确认状态、回滚、重新验证的完整命令序列。
prompt.en: Simulate an AI change that breaks tests: write the full command sequence to confirm state, roll back and re-verify.

hint.zh-CN: 先 git status 确认范围，再 git restore 或 git revert；回滚后重跑测试证明恢复。
hint.en: Confirm scope with git status, then git restore or git revert; rerun tests after rollback to prove recovery.

summary.zh-CN: AI 可能建议新增未知依赖或把密钥直接写进代码；接受依赖前要核对来源与版本，密钥只能来自环境变量或安全配置。
summary.en: AI may propose unknown dependencies or inlined secrets; verify dependency origin and version before accepting, and keep secrets in environment variables or secure configuration.

zh-CN: 审查新增依赖的来源、版本与必要性
识别并修复 prompt/代码中的密钥泄露
en: Review a new dependency's origin, version and necessity
Spot and fix secret leaks in prompts or code

prompt.zh-CN: 检查一次 AI 改动：列出新增依赖、检查是否有密钥进入代码或 prompt、给出 lock 文件与 .gitignore 的整改清单。
prompt.en: Inspect one AI change: list added dependencies, check for secrets entering code or prompts and produce a lockfile and .gitignore remediation list.

hint.zh-CN: 新增依赖要有明确用途与锁定版本；.env 必须被忽略，历史提交泄露要轮换密钥。
hint.en: New dependencies need a clear purpose and pinned version; .env must be ignored and leaked history requires key rotation.

summary.zh-CN: 让 AI 先输出计划（要改哪些文件、分几步、每步怎么验证），人工确认计划后再执行；计划本身也要被审查。
summary.en: Ask the AI for a plan first (files to touch, steps and how each is verified), confirm it, then execute; the plan itself must be reviewed.

zh-CN: 要求 AI 给出带验证方式的改动计划
在计划阶段发现范围过大或方向错误
en: Request a change plan that includes verification
Catch oversized scope or wrong direction at the plan stage

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个 bug 修复写 plan-first prompt：要求先列假设与验证方式，确认后再改代码。
prompt.en: Write a plan-first prompt for a bug fix: list hypotheses and verifications first, change code only after confirmation.

hint.zh-CN: 计划里写明「先只读检查再改」；发现计划要动十个文件时应停下来缩小范围。
hint.en: State 'read-only investigation before edits'; if the plan touches ten files, stop and narrow the scope.

summary.zh-CN: 在需求确认、计划批准、危险操作、提交与发布前设置人工检查点；每个检查点都要求证据齐全才能继续。
summary.en: Set human checkpoints before requirement sign-off, plan approval, dangerous operations, commits and releases; each checkpoint requires complete evidence before continuing.

zh-CN: 为一个开发流程标出必须人工确认的检查点
说明每个检查点需要哪些证据
en: Mark the checkpoints in a workflow that require human confirmation
State the evidence needed at each checkpoint

prompt.zh-CN: 为「AI 修改数据库迁移脚本」这个任务设计检查点：哪些动作必须人工确认，确认前需要看到什么。
prompt.en: Design checkpoints for an AI edit of a database migration: which actions need human confirmation and what must be visible beforehand.

hint.zh-CN: 破坏性操作、密钥操作、提交与发布必须人工确认；确认前展示 diff、测试结果与回滚方案。
hint.en: Destructive operations, secret handling, commits and releases need confirmation; show the diff, test results and rollback plan first.
